question: Mene ne ma'anar morfim (morpheme) a tsarin halittar kalmomi?
explanation: Morfim shi ne karamin sashe na kalma wanda ke da gagarumar ma'ana a cikin harshe.

question: Wane nau'in morfim ne ke iya tsayawa da kansa a matsayin cikakkiyar kalma?
explanation: Morfim mai-yanci (free morpheme) na iya tsayawa shi kadai ya bada ma'ana ta kanta.

question: Wane morfim ne ke bukatan haɗuwa da wani domin samun cikakkiyar ma'ana?
explanation: Morfim dogaro (bound morpheme) ba ya iya tsayawa shi kadai sai an haɗa shi da wani.

question: A cikin kalmar 'malami', wane sashe ne tushen kalmar?
explanation: Tushen kalmar shi ne 'mal' wanda daga gare shi ake fitar da sauran sassan.

question: Wane abu ne ake kira 'allomorph' a fannin ilimin halittar kalmomi?
explanation: Allomorphs sune siffofi daban-daban na wuri ko furci na guda daya daga cikin morfim.

question: Idan aka ɗauki kalmar 'bature', wane sashe ne yake nuna jinsi ko tushe?
explanation: Gabatarwa 'ba-' tana zama morfim mai nuna asali ko mutum.

question: Ta yaya ake kiran ƙarin morfim da aka sanya a farkon tushen kalma?
explanation: Gabatarwa (prefix) ita ce morfim din da ake sanyawa a gaban tushen kalma.

question: Menene aikinsu babban na ƙarin morfim (suffix) a jikin kalma?
explanation: Ana amfani da suffix don sauya ajin kalma ko kuma ƙara mata wata ma'ana ta musamman.

question: A cikin harshen Hausa, shin tushen kalma na iya zama fi'ili?
explanation: Tushen kalma a Hausa na iya zama suna, fi'ili ko sifa.

question: Wane suna ne ake baiwa tsarin da ke nazarin yadda ake haɗa morfimi wuri guda?
explanation: Ilimin halittar kalmomi (Morphology) shi ne ke nazarin tsari da haɗin morfim.

question: Wace kalma ce take nuna suna a cikin Hausa?
explanation: Kalmar 'Bature' sunan mutum ne, wanda hakan ya sa ta zama suna.

question: Wane irin sifa ce kalmar 'jan'?
explanation: Kalmar 'jan' tana bayyana launin wani abu.

question: Wace kalma ce ke nuna aikatau (verb)?
explanation: Rubuta yana nufin yin aikin rubutu, don haka shi ne aikatau.

question: Menene ma'anar kalmar 'ƙarami' a fannin sifa?
explanation: Ƙarami yana nufin wani abu mai ƙarancin girma.

question: Wanne ne misalin sunan wuri?
explanation: Kano sunan birni ne ko wuri.

question: Wanne ne ke nuna wuri ko yadda ake abu (matsayi)?
explanation: Bayanau yana ƙara bayani kan aikatau ta fuskar wuri ko yadda aka yi shi.

question: A cikin 'Ya tafi da sauri', wace kalma ce bayanau?
explanation: Sauri yana nuna yadda tafiyar ta gudana, wanda shi ne bayanau.

question: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan sunaye ne na abu marar rai?
explanation: Tebur abu ne da ba shi da rai idan aka kwatanta da sauran.

question: Wace kalma ce maye-gurbin suna (pronoun)?
explanation: 'Shi' kalma ce da ake amfani da ita a madadin suna.

question: Wane rukunin kalma ne 'kuma' yake ciki?
explanation: 'Kuma' kalma ce da ake amfani da ita wajen haɗa batutuwa ko jumla.

question: Wace ce hanyar gina sabuwar kalma ta hanyar hada kalmomi biyu masu zaman kansu?
explanation: Hadewa ita ce hanya mafi sauki ta hada kalmomi biyu domin samar da sabuwar ma'ana daya.

question: Mene ne ake nufi da ginin kalma ta hanyar 'Arba' a Hausa?
explanation: Arba ko aro yana nufin karbar kalma daga wani yare kamar Larabci da shigar da ita cikin Hausa.

question: Wace hanya ce ake amfani da ita wajen rage tsawon kalma amma ana nufin abu daya?
explanation: Takaitawa ko gajartawa ita ce hanyar da ake rage girman kalma ko jimloli zuwa ga gajeren siffa.

question: Ana samun sabuwar kalma a Hausa ta hanyar sanya wani sashe a farkon tushen kalma. Wane ne?
explanation: Gabatarwa ko 'prefix' shi ne sanya harafi ko sashi a farkon kalma domin gina sabuwar ma'ana.

question: Idan aka kara wani sashi a karshen tushen kalma don samar da sabuwar ma'ana, ana kiransa:
explanation: Bayanwa ko 'suffix' shi ne karin da ake yi a karshen tushen kalma.

question: Wace ce hanyar gina kalma ta hanyar maimaita wani sashi na farkon kalmar?
explanation: Maimaitawa ko reduplication tana daya daga cikin hanyoyin gina sabbin kalmomi da jaddadawa a Hausa.

question: Kalmar 'danboko' misali ce ta wace hanyar gina kalmomi?
explanation: Kalmar 'danboko' ta kunshi 'dan' da 'boko' wadanda aka hada su suka zama kalma daya.

question: Menene aikin 'shigar da baki' ko 'aronsu' a tsarin ginin kalmomin Hausa?
explanation: Aras da shigar da kalmomin waje yana taimakawa wajen bunkasa da wadatar da kamus din Hausa.

question: Wace hanya ce ta samar da sabuwar kalma ta hanyar sauya sautin wasali ko lankwasa shi?
explanation: Sauya sauti ko sautin wasali na iya canza jinsi ko ma'anar kalma a tsarin Hausa.

question: Ta wace hanya ne ake kiran kalmomin da aka kirkira saboda kamanceceniya da sautin abin?
explanation: Kwaikwayon sauti (onomatopoeia) hanya ce ta gina kalmomi dake bayyana kalar sautin wani abu.

question: Wane sauye-sauyen sauti ne ke faruwa idan 'baki' ya hadu da 'ni' ya zama 'bakina'?
explanation: Ana samun rage sauti ko faduwar harafi wajen gina kalmomi domin sauƙaƙa furuci.

question: Wane sauyi ake samu idan kalmar 'gida' ta koma 'gidaje' a jam'i?
explanation: An kara sautuka ne da sassanta domin nuna jam'i a cikin kalmar.

question: Sauyin sautin da ke faruwa lokacin da 'mai' ta zama 'maci' ana kiransa da?
explanation: Sauyin kusanci yana faruwa ne idan sautuka suka yi tasiri a kan juna suka zama iri ɗaya ko kusa.

question: Menene ya faru ga sautin /h/ idan 'fari' ya zama 'farau'?
explanation: An sauya harafin /i/ zuwa /u/ ta hanyar maye gurbin sauti a matsayin sauyi.

question: Idan 'baba' ya koma 'babi' a wani harshe ko yanki, wane nau'in sauyi ne?
explanation: Sauyin wasali yana faruwa ne lokacin da aka sauya wasali ɗaya da wani a kalma.

question: Wane suna ne ake ba wa ɓacewar wani sauti saboda tsananin saurin furuci?
explanation: Rage sauti kan faruwa ne domin sauƙaƙa furta doguwar kalma.

question: Wane sauyi ke faruwa idan 'baki' da 'ka' suka zama 'bakinka'?
explanation: Kalmomi biyu sun haɗu sun zama ɗaya tare da ɗan taƙaitawa a tsarin sautinsu.

question: Sauyin da ke sanya baƙi su zama iri ɗaya a kalma ɗaya ana ce masa?
explanation: Sauyin kusanci ko tasirin sauti na faruwa ne idan baƙi suka yi wa juna tasiri.

question: Idan aka mai da 'yaro' zuwa 'yara', wane irin sauyi ne ya faru a ƙarshen kalmar?
explanation: An canza wasalin ƙarshe /o/ zuwa /a/ domin sauya yanayin kalmar.

question: Menene tushen sauyin sauti a cikin harshen Hausa?
explanation: Manufar sauye-sauyen sauti ita ce sauƙaƙa wa harshe furta kalmomi ba tare da wahala ba.

question: Wace ce haɗakar kalmomi da ke nufin 'mutum mai rowa'?
explanation: Mai hannun sanda ko matse hannu na nufin mutum mai rowa. Wannan yana daga cikin misalan ƙarin magana ko haɗakar kalmomi ta Hausa.

question: Menene ma'anar haɗakar kalmoma 'ci da zuciya'?
explanation: Ci da zuciya na nufin nuna fushi ko jin haushi a cikin rai sakamakon wani abin da ya faru.

question: Wace kalma ce za a haɗa da 'baki' domin nufin 'mutum mai magana sosai'?
explanation: Baki mai-faɗi ko baki biyu na iya nuna halin mutum, amma 'baki mai-faɗi' yana nufin mai yawan magana.

question: Menene ma'anar haɗakar kalmomi 'Kafar unguwa'?
explanation: Kafar unguwa na nufin babban taron jama'a ko kuma sanannen mutum a cikin unguwa.

question: Haɗakar kalmomi 'bikin suna' tana nufin me?
explanation: Bikin suna shine shagalin da ake yi don sanar da sunan da aka saka wa sabon haihuwa.

question: Wane ne 'ɗan gata' a cikin al'umma?
explanation: Ɗan gata shine mutum ko yaro da ake nuna masa soyayya ta musamman da fifiko a kan wasu.

question: Menene ma'anar haɗakar kalmomi 'zafin nama'?
explanation: Zafin nama yana nufin aikin gaggawa, azama, ko kuma kwarewa wajen gudanar da abu.

question: Wace ce haɗakar kalmomin da ke nufin 'cin hanci'?
explanation: Karɓar baya ko cin hanci na nufin karɓar wani abu a ɓoye don yin abin da bai dace ba.

question: Menene ma'anar 'mai baki biyu'?
explanation: Mai baki biyu shine mutumin da baya zance ɗaya, wanda yake munafunci ko marar gaskiya.

question: Haɗakar kalmomi 'gidan sauro' tana nufin me?
explanation: Gidan sauro wata na'ura ce ko zane da ake rufewa don kariya daga cizon sauro.
